Running a business comes with a lot to manage. We’re here to make it easier.

Whether it’s helping your team look their best, keeping your facility clean and safe, or staying
ready for whatever the day brings, Cintas supports businesses of every size across workwear,
facilities, first aid & safety, fire protection, and beyond.

With dependable service and operational excellence, we help you solve problems before they slow you
down.

Together, we create better, safer, more professional workdays.

printers, ink & toner, and more. We have all the tools you need to stay productive and connected,

technology, gaming consoles & accessories, décor, and gift cards.

lunch boxes. Teachers will appreciate our extensive selection of classroom essentials, including
educational materials, classroom decor, organizational tools, and more. [Find your school supply

# Staples drives your business with an extensive product assortment wherever you need it.

At Staples, we’ve been providing our customers with an extensive assortment of essential office
supplies for over 35 years. From writing supplies and paper to shredders and school supplies,
Staples is the [office supply][123] expert. We are a top provider of office chairs, desks, tables &
office furniture. We also offer the latest technology—from laptops, computers & accessories, to
printers, ink & toner, and more. We have all the tools you need to stay productive and connected,
plus a wide assortment of unexpected [new & trending products][124] like luggage, smart home
technology, gaming consoles & accessories, décor, and gift cards.


[Staples has everything you could ever need for school.]

### Back to School Made Easy at Staples

For students and parents, Staples is a one-stop shop for all [school supplies][125]. Parents and
students can find everything they need to succeed, from notebooks and art materials to backpacks and
lunch boxes. Teachers will appreciate our extensive selection of classroom essentials, including
educational materials, classroom decor, organizational tools, and more. [Find your school supply
list][126] & shop for everything you need, all in one place!


[Wireless headphones are essential while traveling.]

### Staples Travel Hub

Whether your next trip is for business or pleasure, [Staples Travel Hub][127] is your new
destination for all things travel. Find luggage and travel accessories, and tech gadgets to make
your trip run smoothly. Visit us in-store to take advantage of our [TSA PreCheck][128] and passport
services.


[Prioritizing wellness throughout your day.]

### Health & Wellness

Staples range of [health & wellness products][129] can enhance your workspace and overall
well-being. Shop ergonomic furniture & tech options, as well as smart watches, candles, essential
oils & more. Our curved whiteboard has an ergonomically crafted shape to prevent strain. And a new
selection of [guided journals][130] are available, with topics including anxiety & productivity.


[Take advantage of Staples EasyRewards and AutoRestock and check another thing off your list for
good.]

### Perks of Shopping Staples

We pride ourselves on making shopping a breeze. With [Staples Easy Rewards][131], you can earn
rewards on every purchase, plus extra rewards on your chosen bonus categories. Our
[AutoRestock][132] feature ensures you never run out of essential supplies, with easy-to-manage
subscriptions. Whether you prefer to shop in-store or online, we offer flexible options for
shipping, same-day delivery, or in-store pickup.



At Staples, we are here to help you navigate your business, office, and school needs with ease.
Explore our website and discover all that Staples has to offer. We're confident you will find
exactly what you're looking for and more.

selection of [guided journals][130] are available, with topics including anxiety & productivity.

[AutoRestock][132] feature ensures you never run out of essential supplies, with easy-to-manage
subscriptions. Whether you prefer to shop in-store or online, we offer flexible options for
shipping, same-day delivery, or in-store pickup.

# Free non-stigmatizing photos about drugs and alcohol

## Search the collection or [browse by category][9]

Generic selectors

## Featured Images

[[Syringe services program staff showing client a naloxone nasal spray device.]][10]
[[Community health or drug treatment provider describing urine drug screen process to client.]][11]
[[Service window at a syringe services program with a sign marketing different supplies and lots of
informational materials]][12]
[[Two vials of intramuscular naloxone 0.4mg/mL sitting on a wooden table next to a packaged syringe
and some other supplies.]][13]
[[Person checking in at the front desk of a recovery support organization listens while a staff
person points at a ledger and explains the process]][14]
[[Two packages of fentanyl test strips sitting on a table with a couple of small vials of water and
some small cookers/bowls in the background that can be used to combine a sample of a substance with
the water for dipping the test strips in.]][15]
[[A staff person of a syringe services program’s mobile services van wearing a blue surgical mask
hands some blue latex gloves from a box to a smiling client wearing a tan hoodie.]][16]
[[Close-up of a black box with dividers in a syringe services program that contains multiple small
items, like hand wipes, CPR shields, fentanyl test strips, etc.]][17]
[[Drug checking technician holding a sample of substance in a small white cup with several test
strips in it, each with a different color on the tip.]][18]
[[A client with a blue hoodie and a blue surgical mask sits at a table with a provider or peer
support specialist, also masked. The provider/peer is showing them something on a laptop as they
talk.]][19]
[[Patient in jeans and a jacket approaching the steps to enter a community health / syringe services
program mobile clinic van]][20]
[[A window and counter at a syringe services program. Behind the counter is a staff person with
short hair, glasses, and a shirt that reads “Ask me about naloxone” in multiple languages. They are
gesturing with their hands as they talk to a client across the counter with long dark hair and a
blue shirt.]][21]
[[A syringe services program staff person is blurred in the background, holding a box of syringes in
one hand and a packet of syringes in the other while talking to a client in a black and yellow shirt
across a counter.]][22]
[[A client wearing a tan hoodie reaches out to take a brown paper bag of safer use supplies from a
staff person in a syringe services program’s mobile services van. The staff person is wearing a blue
surgical mask.]][23]
[[Patient/client sitting across desk from drug checking technician talking about drug checking
analysis shown on computer screen.]][24]
[[A single-use naloxone nasal spray atomizer in yellow and blue packaging sitting up against the box
it came in on a wooden table.]][25]
[[Close-up of a row of supply shelves in a syringe services program.]][26]
[[Close-up, angled, horizontal photo of clear acrylic wall rack holding several colorful educational
/ informational brochures and pamphlets in English and Spanish.]][27]

Alcohol Institute**][28], features **free photographs** related to drug and alcohol use, prevention,
treatment, recovery, and harm reduction. The goal of this project is to reduce **stigma against
people who use drugs and the services available to support them** by encouraging the use of
realistic, humanizing imagery in education, media, and other forms of information dissemination.
[**Learn more about the Empathy Lens project here**][29].

work. **Washington State residents** can also order up to 50 copies in print **free** from the

Private Label Partnerships

## Extend your brand and differentiate your company

Partnering with PRIMED allows access to our trusted and known, clinically preferred products while
showcasing your company with comprehensive brand enhancement. We offer a full suite of services from
packaging design to foundational market knowledge, and our North American team is experienced and
passionate to drive your success.

**Your brand is our business.**

[Learn more about our Private Label offerings][47]
[Manufacturing Plant Employee Packaging Gowns into boxes]
BEST OF BOTH WORLDS

## Our products are designed for the highest levels of protection and comfort

As it is with many medical products, clinicians must choose between comfort and functionality, but
we believe clinicians should have it all. This is why all of our products come with protection,
functionality, and comfort engineered right in.
[Surgeons in full PPE performing surgery]

### No detail is too small

Every PRIMED medical product is designed with purpose and informed by the medical professionals who
use them. Guided by our commitment to quality, each product passes multiple inputs and inspections -
ensuring it meets our high quality standards.

### Clinical expertise

One unique aspect of PRIMED is our track record for improving industry’s protection standards. Our
dedicated product development teams continually push the product innovation envelope, and along with
it, industry’s expectations of safety and reliability.

[Nurse and Surgeon in Hospital Hallway]
industries

## No matter what work you do, you should be safe and comfortable

As a result of the past few years, the use of facial protection has become common outside of
hospitals and clinics. PPE is now a well-known term among the general public. Our masks are used in
food, industrial, and retail industries and our gloves and self-adherent wraps are used in tattoo
shops and vet clinics. It's safe to say that our products are for everyone, not just doctors and
clinicians.

# Provide a layer of protection for Socks or Shoes

TSA checkpoints are a necessary part of travel, but the thought of walking barefoot or in socks on
the cold, filthy floor can make anyone uneasy. Similarly, the idea of slipping your feet into shared
footwear, like bowling shoes, raises concerns about what dirt and grime you could be bringing home.

**Steppeys®** are here to put those worries to rest. Our product is expertly designed to shield your
socks from dirt and grime lurking on these surfaces, providing a barrier between your socks

and floor grime.

*****Steppeys® should be worn with socks on at all times.*****

## ENGINEERED WITH YOUR Travels IN MIND

**Steppeys®** aren't just a physical barrier from dirty floors and shared footwear; they're a
technological marvel. Constructed from EPA approved elements, **Steppeys®** don't just protect —
they also inhibit the growth of odor causing bacteria on the surface of the barrier. It's like
having a personal cleaning crew for your socks and shoes, ensuring that every step you take helps
keep your shoes and socks clean.

## EASY PEEL AND STICK SOCK PROTECTOR

We believe you shouldn't have to sacrifice convenience for your own protection. That's why Steppeys®
are designed to be user-friendly. Steppeys® are lightweight, easy to apply and remove, and are
compatible with all types of socks and shoes. Whether you're traveling, engaging in recreational
activities, or just lounging at home, Steppeys® integrate seamlessly into your lifestyle.
[ Get steppeys® ][55]

## Embrace the Cleanliness Revolution

In today's world, where hygiene and cleanliness are paramount, **Steppeys®** offer a simple yet
effective solution to a problem you might not have realized existed. They are more than just a
protective layer; they're a commitment to maintaining cleanliness and well-being in every aspect of
your life.

Our **Steppeys®** provide an innovative approach to personal hygiene, you're not just protecting
your socks; you're taking a step towards a cleaner, safer, and more confident lifestyle. Welcome to
the next level of sock protection, welcome to **Steppeys®**.

## Every single person at Thetford makes the difference

While we come from different backgrounds and cultures, we all have and share the same values in the
way we work with each other.

We do not just make products, we create them. Every step we make together with our colleagues. We
imagine, create, develop, produce, transport and support.

We work together with thinkers and with doers, so we can act global, think local and do what we
love.

[toss ins 16ct aqua kem resized]

### Blue is back!

One of our most popular RV holding tank treatments, Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins®, has returned. Perfect for
RVs and marine applications, the Bronopol-based formula liquefies waste, breaks down tissue, and
delivers superior odor control.

[ Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins® ][67]
[Thetford Aqua Magic VI Homepage Banner]

### Constantly improving RV sanitation

Introducing the Aqua-Magic® VI, a lightweight RV toilet designed to bring the comfort of a home
toilet to your travels, along with easy cleaning and low maintenance.

[ Aqua-Magic® VI ][68]
[Titan Tote 4 wheel Airstream Homepage Banner]

### Changing the standards

At Thetford®, we never stop looking for ways to improve and break patterns. Titan® portable totes
have the industry’s lowest fill height. This makes allows easy emptying for even the lowest RV waste
valves.

## Every single person at Thetford makes the difference

While we come from different backgrounds and cultures, we all have and share the same values in the
way we work with each other.

We do not just make products, we create them. Every step we make together with our colleagues. We
imagine, create, develop, produce, transport and support.

We work together with thinkers and with doers, so we can act global, think local and do what we
love.

[toss ins 16ct aqua kem resized]

### Blue is back!

One of our most popular RV holding tank treatments, Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins®, has returned. Perfect for
RVs and marine applications, the Bronopol-based formula liquefies waste, breaks down tissue, and
delivers superior odor control.

[ Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins® ][67]
[Thetford Aqua Magic VI Homepage Banner]

### Constantly improving RV sanitation

Introducing the Aqua-Magic® VI, a lightweight RV toilet designed to bring the comfort of a home
toilet to your travels, along with easy cleaning and low maintenance.

[ Aqua-Magic® VI ][68]
[Titan Tote 4 wheel Airstream Homepage Banner]

### Changing the standards

At Thetford®, we never stop looking for ways to improve and break patterns. Titan® portable totes
have the industry’s lowest fill height. This makes allows easy emptying for even the lowest RV waste
valves.

[ Portable totes ][69]

###### About Unimax

## Leading Manufacturer of Non-woven PPE & Medical Disposables.

Unimax Medical (est. 2002) is a China-based manufacturer of Disposable PPE and Medical Consumables,
exporting to 100+ countries worldwide. We operate three certified facilities in Wuhan, Xiantao and
Xiaogan — spanning 80,000 m² with over 20,000 m² of Class 100,000 cleanrooms, featuring 500+
production machines — offering end-to-end solutions from raw materials to finished products,
integrating R&D, manufacturing, and EO sterilization. Certified to ISO, CE, FDA, UKCA, BSCI,
EcoVadis and Sedex, we ensure quality and compliance for global customers.

Welcome to WorkGlovesDepot.com, your one-stop shop for top-quality work gloves, safety gear, and
protective equipment at unbeatably low prices! Our mission is to provide quality products at
affordable prices, ensuring that everyone can stay safe and comfortable on the job. We are dedicated
to offering an extensive range of hand protection options, including cut-resistant gloves,
chemical-resistant gloves, leather gloves, disposable gloves, and more, to suit every industry,
task, and personal preference. Our exclusive JustForKids brand features kids-sized garden gloves and
work gloves for our littlest helpers. With our expertly curated selection, expert advice, and
unparalleled customer service, you can trust us to help you find the perfect pair of gloves to meet
your unique needs. At WorkGlovesDepot.com, experience the confidence that comes from knowing your
hands are well-protected with our comprehensive safety solutions, all while enjoying unbeatable

### About The Shop

Welcome to WorkGlovesDepot.com, your one-stop shop for top-quality work gloves, safety gear, and
protective equipment at unbeatably low prices! Our mission is to provide quality products at
affordable prices, ensuring that everyone can stay safe and comfortable on the job. We are dedicated
to offering an extensive range of hand protection options, including cut-resistant gloves,
chemical-resistant gloves, leather gloves, disposable gloves, and more, to suit every industry,
task, and personal preference. Our exclusive JustForKids brand features kids-sized garden gloves and
work gloves for our littlest helpers. With our expertly curated selection, expert advice, and
unparalleled customer service, you can trust us to help you find the perfect pair of gloves to meet
your unique needs. At WorkGlovesDepot.com, experience the confidence that comes from knowing your
hands are well-protected with our comprehensive safety solutions, all while enjoying unbeatable
value.

## Your destination for business supplies, equipment, and tools

Shop at Zoro and find millions of premium products from thousands of trusted brands, including
tools, office supplies, industrial equipment, safety products, and much more. Discover everything
you need to keep your business running at one convenient online supplier, with free shipping on
orders over $50 when you sign in or sign up for an account. Count on great perks that make your
shopping experience even easier, including Net 30 terms and tax-exempt purchases for qualifying
customers, no-hassle returns, and excellent U.S.-based customer service from people who truly care.

As a leader in the maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) industry, Zoro carries the hard-to-find
products, tools, equipment, and replacement parts you need to support your business, facility, or
warehouse, no matter your size—from small to medium-sized companies to large enterprises. Shop our
huge selection of hand and power tools from top brands like Milwaukee, DeWalt, Stanley, Westward,
and so many more. Keep your facility and employees safe with personal protective equipment (PPE)
including eye protection, gloves and hand protection, as well as fire protection and lockout/tagout
products. You’ll also find plumbing equipment, electrical supplies, heating and cooling parts and
products, and so much more. With over 12 million products and counting, we are constantly adding to
our endless assortment, so you can find the products you need, when you need them, and get them
shipped fast.

## Your destination for business supplies, equipment, and tools

Shop at Zoro and find millions of premium products from thousands of trusted brands, including
tools, office supplies, industrial equipment, safety products, and much more. Discover everything
you need to keep your business running at one convenient online supplier, with free shipping on
orders over $50 when you sign in or sign up for an account. Count on great perks that make your
shopping experience even easier, including Net 30 terms and tax-exempt purchases for qualifying
customers, no-hassle returns, and excellent U.S.-based customer service from people who truly care.

As a leader in the maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) industry, Zoro carries the hard-to-find
products, tools, equipment, and replacement parts you need to support your business, facility, or
warehouse, no matter your size—from small to medium-sized companies to large enterprises. Shop our
huge selection of hand and power tools from top brands like Milwaukee, DeWalt, Stanley, Westward,
and so many more. Keep your facility and employees safe with personal protective equipment (PPE)
including eye protection, gloves and hand protection, as well as fire protection and lockout/tagout
products. You’ll also find plumbing equipment, electrical supplies, heating and cooling parts and
products, and so much more. With over 12 million products and counting, we are constantly adding to
our endless assortment, so you can find the products you need, when you need them, and get them
shipped fast.
